import json,re,os
rows=json.load(open(os.environ['TMPDIR']+'/work/rows.json'))
UTIL=["centerpoint","northern indiana public service","nipsco","citizens gas","citizens energy","vectren","indiana american water","ohio valley gas","american electric power","duke energy","community natural gas","midwest natural gas","frontier communications"]
def is_util(n):
    n=(n or '').strip().lower(); return any(n.startswith(u) for u in UTIL)
def headline(p):
    if not p: return 0
    m=re.search(r'\$+\s*(\d{1,3}(?:,\s*\d{3})+|\d+)',p)
    return int(re.sub(r'[,\s]','',m.group(1))) if m else 0
for y in (2023,2024):
    rs=[r for r in rows if r['year']==y]
    # respondent unknown for 28073 -> treat as non-utility (sensitivity: utility)
    nonu=[r for r in rs if not is_util(r['respondent'])]
    hp=[headline(r['pen_raw']) for r in nonu]
    n5=sum(1 for h in hp if h>=5000)
    util=[r for r in rs if is_util(r['respondent'])]
    print(f"{y}: all={len(rs)} nonutil={len(nonu)} nonutil>=5000={n5} -> {100*n5/len(nonu):.1f}% | util={len(util)} -> {100*len(util)/len(rs):.1f}%")
    # sensitivity excluding unknown respondent
    nonu2=[r for r in nonu if r['case']!='28073']
    n52=sum(1 for r in nonu2 if headline(r['pen_raw'])>=5000)
    print(f"   excl. unknown-respondent case: nonutil={len(nonu2)} >=5000={n52} -> {100*n52/len(nonu2):.1f}%")
    print("   utility names:", sorted(set(r['respondent'] for r in util))[:20])
EOF
